BiblicalUsage: Peyah is an edge, and it appears once, on Ehud's dagger. He makes a two-edged dagger a cubit long and girds it under his raiment upon his right thigh, and with it he kills Eglon king of Moab.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a two-edged dagger hidden under a cloak is the whole story of Ehud: God uses a left-handed man and a short blade to free His people.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
